column7: admin restore staged key files without fsyncing their directories before writing the restore journal: power loss could keep the journal and the committed data but lose a staged key file in another directory, and admin restore --recover read the missing staged file as already installed, removed the journal and left the OLD keys beside the NEW data. The journal write now fsyncs every staged-file directory first, each entry records the SHA-256 of its staged content, and recovery checks every entry before the first rename: a missing staged file counts as installed only if the live file has that hash, and an altered staged file is never installed; otherwise recovery refuses and changes nothing. Red on 46edb1732 (recovery rolled forward on both backends). Also TestAdminRestoreRecover_RefusesDamagedStagedKeyFile, TestAdminRestoreRecover_RefusesForeignWitnessPath, TestWrite_SyncsEveryStagedDirectoryBeforeTheJournal.
